text:
maria_cs: Quick check-in for Acadia Health private deployment — final alignment needed on network egress rules, KMS key policy, and audit log retention before cutover. Can we confirm gaps?

kai_infra: I pushed the VPC changes last night. Security groups allow outbound 443 and 8053 for internal metadata. Still waiting on confirmation for NAT gw sizing and egress proxy IP ranges. :thinking: 

devon_security: @kai_infra please paste the current SG snippet. Also we need the KMS key policy to include the ops-monitoring role for decrypt/read-only access for log processing.

kai_infra: SG snippet:
```
- Type: outbound
  Protocol: TCP
  Ports: 443, 8053
  Destination: 0.0.0.0/0 (NAT)
```
I know it's broad; we plan to lock to egress-proxy CIDR once infra confirms static IPs.

maria_cs: Ops asked for audit logs to S3 with 365-day retention. Is that in place? We also promised the customer KMS rotation policy aligned with their compliance docs.

sam_eng: Logs are flowing but we noticed CloudTrail events for AssumeRole weren't being forwarded to the central bucket —looks like a misconfig in the bucket policy. I opened a PR to add the correct principal.

devon_security: For KMS, prefer to use a customer-managed symmetric key with a key policy like:
```
- Allow: principal arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:role/ops-monitoring
  Actions: kms:Decrypt, kms:DescribeKey
  Condition: StringEquals kms:ViaService sts.amazonaws.com
```
We also need to confirm CMK key rotation schedule with the customer (annual vs 90 days).

maria_cs: Customer signoff needed on rotation cadence. They've historically preferred annual rotation but their audit team is asking about 90-day proof. I'll loop them in and get a decision by EOD.

kai_infra: Regarding NAT sizing: current estimate supports 500 RPS egress bursts. If they expect >1k RPS concurrent we should provision an autoscaling NAT or an additional gateway. Any traffic pattern docs from Acadia?

maria_cs: They've shared a 6-week ramp doc — peak expected ~700 RPS during batch windows. I think autoscale NAT would be safer. I'll attach the doc in the ticket.

devon_security: One more item: audit log integrity. We need S3 Object Lock (governance) for the central bucket and cross-account replication disabled for now until lifecycle is set. Can infra verify?

kai_infra: Object Lock enabled on the bucket, retention 365d set. Replication is off. Will add the bucket policy change for AssumeRole.

obs-bot: monitor: CloudTrail pipeline alert fired 3h ago — 1 missing event (AssumeRole) — resolved with PR #412. :white_check_mark:

maria_cs: Great. Action list for cutover: 1) Confirm NAT autoscale provisioning (kai) 2) Finalize KMS key policy + rotation cadence (devon + customer) 3) Update bucket policy for AssumeRole (kai) 4) Confirm audit retention & Object Lock (kai/devon) 5) Customer signoff on egress IPs (maria)

sam_eng: I'll standby for the PR review for the bucket policy, can do a quick deploy once you merge.

maria_cs: Thanks — I'll ping when customer confirms rotation cadence and egress CIDRs. If we don't have signoff by 18:00 PT we hold cutover to tomorrow. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

devon_security: Noted. Ping me if they choose 90-day rotation, we'll need to update KMS CMK rotation and note in the compliance checklist.

kai_infra: Working on NAT autoscale playbook now, ETA 2h.

maria_cs: Perfect — keeping this thread as the single-source sync. I'll post the customer's reply here when I have it. :raised_hands:
